name: Phlac-Arphocc Prototype
description: The Phlac-Arphocc Prototype was a sample model of the droid tri-fighter, manufactured by Phlac-Arphocc Automata Industries. From the prototype, the tri-fighter became one of the greatest aerospace superiority starfighters in the galaxy, and the most feared and hated model in the Confederacy of Independent Systems' arsenal. It was equipped with vectoring engine units and one medium laser cannon accompanied by three light laser cannons.
